instructions: Be terse. Skip preamble and pleasantries. State the issue, why it matters, and the fix. Prefer suggested diffs over prose.

rules.rule: Prefer minimal diffs. Do not add error handling, fallbacks, or validation for cases that cannot happen at internal call sites; validate only at system boundaries (HTTP input, external APIs). Avoid speculative abstractions; three similar lines beat a premature helper.
Default to no comments. Only flag a missing comment when the WHY is non-obvious (a hidden constraint, a workaround, a subtle invariant). Comments must not reference ticket numbers or review bots.
Authorization runs before any resource lookup. An unauthorized caller gets 403 whether or not the resource exists; never reveal existence via 404.

Queries must stay tenant-scoped. Flag bun's Count, Exists and ScanAndCount (they skip the TenantScoped BeforeSelect hook; use repository.CountRows / RowsExist), and raw bun.Conn SQL using $1 placeholders instead of ?.
Skip stylistic prose nits. Only flag factual errors, broken code samples, or stale references (renamed files, removed flags, deleted endpoints).
